description: This source file defines the `TablePropertyPanel` class, a Swing GUI component used for displaying detailed properties of a `Table` object within the RomRaider tuning software. It includes UI elements for showing the table's category, name, description, storage details, log parameters, and associated scales or switch states.

classes.name: TablePropertyPanel
classes.description: A Swing JPanel subclass that displays various properties of a Table object, including category, name, description, storage information, user level, and associated scales or switch states.

methods.name: populateScalesTable
methods.description: Creates a JTable populated with a list of Scale objects, using a custom table model for scales.

methods.name: populateScalesTable
methods.description: Creates a JTable populated with switch state mappings, using a custom table model for switch states.

methods.name: createScalesTable
methods.description: Constructs a JTable given a table model, configuring selection and viewport settings.

methods.name: populateLogParamTable
methods.description: Generates a JTable showing log parameter key-value pairs parsed from a string, with column width customization.
